records.summary: The Data Analytics Hub launch frames community analytics as a shared practice space where churches compare dashboards, ministry processes, BI tooling, and Rock-based reporting patterns. The session also includes a Life.Church attendance-flow case study that uses Rock attendance and connection data to prioritize pastoral follow-up while treating AI profile summaries and privacy controls as governance concerns.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session is useful as public-safe context for community practice around emerging technology, mobile launches, and finance/workflow requests. It does not provide a single product tutorial, but it reinforces that Rock teams should bring concrete use cases to peer review, document what was tried, and separate experimentation from production changes.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This RockCast episode adds public-safe context for the Rock Mobile transition from Xamarin Forms toward .NET MAUI. It describes MAUI as a close successor with compatibility support, newer styling and animation options, performance improvements, and a release path that lets existing apps test compatibility before fully moving new content blocks to MAUI-native behavior.
records.title: Episode 143: Special Edition- Braden Cohen Transcript Insight

records.summary: Mobile check-in configuration depends on creating virtual check-in kiosk devices, assigning geofenced campus boundaries, and pointing the Mobile Check-in Launcher block at the correct devices, check-in configuration, theme, and areas.
records.title: Mobile Check-in Configuration Transcript Insight

records.summary: This official Rock AI Summit recording introduces Rock IQ and walks through the full AI Agent framework: staff chat, MCP and voice demonstrations; agent, skill and tool security; Connected Services onboarding; early church and partner prototypes; exploratory MCP UI and knowledge-base ideas; and detailed Lava tool-building guidance. Use the recording for product context, demonstrations and rollout lessons, while using current written documentation, release notes and live configuration as the authority for implementation and availability.
records.title: AI Summit: The Community's First Look at Rock's AI Agents Transcript Insight

records.summary: The Data Analytics Hub launch frames community analytics as a shared practice space where churches compare dashboards, ministry processes, BI tooling, and Rock-based reporting patterns. The session also includes a Life.Church attendance-flow case study that uses Rock attendance and connection data to prioritize pastoral follow-up while treating AI profile summaries and privacy controls as governance concerns.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Data Analytics Hub walkthrough gives public-safe guidance for building a layered Rock reporting suite with Power BI or similar tools. It distinguishes executive, campus/ministry, and functional reporting, emphasizes comparison against goals or history, and shows when scheduled refreshes, live queries, Rock security roles, and embedded report pages each fit.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session gives public-safe guidance for using first-time guest and retention measures as a connection strategy input. It emphasizes defining the few metrics that matter, comparing retention patterns over time, and using data to improve follow-up without replacing the relational work of connecting new people to ministry.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session provides a strategy frame for using web, mobile, and communication channels to build digital connections that move people toward real ministry engagement. It is useful context for KB guidance where Rock CMS, Rock Mobile, content channels, and communications support the same connection path rather than isolated digital projects.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session provides public-safe guidance for curating sermon or message content from external video analytics into a ministry-facing content library. It highlights the gap between YouTube-style analytics and Rock-backed ministry context, and it encourages topic tagging, content selection, and analytics exports that can guide what to feature without exposing raw platform data unnecessarily.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Data Analytics Hub walkthrough describes a Rock-based journey engagement dashboard that combines content-channel journey definitions, group/member participation, group member attendance, campus filters, persisted datasets, and Lava chart shortcodes to help ministry teams evaluate engagement and improve content strategy.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session adds practical LMS guidance from churches beginning to build training content in Rock. It treats LMS as a way to deliver volunteer and staff training, reuse existing teaching assets, and pair content with communications that invite people into structured learning rather than leaving training scattered across unrelated pages.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session adds public-safe guidance for building a modular daily experience in a church mobile app. It describes using Rock Mobile as a recurring engagement surface for devotion, content, and practical next steps, with emphasis on flexible modules and analytics that show whether people return and engage over time.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session provides public-safe guidance for mobile app experiences that overlap with Rock groups, dynamic content, and engagement tracking. It frames the mobile app as a ministry surface where groups, content modules, profile-aware data, and communications can support a more personalized path for insiders.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session focuses on short-form and on-demand video as part of a broader church digital strategy. It frames video as a way to extend message content, answer timely questions, route people into deeper next steps, and support mobile or web experiences that help people continue engaging after the weekend.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session captures LCBC's SEO content strategy discussion and adds public-safe guidance for Rock website teams. It frames SEO as an ongoing content and measurement discipline: define the audience questions, publish useful pages, connect public content to next steps, and measure outcomes without treating search traffic as a ministry goal by itself.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session adds public-safe guidance for aligning communications, content strategy, SEO, and ministry teams. It frames communication work as a cross-ministry operating system: teams need shared priorities, clear content ownership, measurable outcomes, and Rock-supported paths that connect public content to next steps.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: Compiling the shell and publishing apps to the stores is a complicated process that requires a good deal of technical proficiency. records.summary: Java Keystores (.jks or .keystore) are binary files that serve as repositories of certificates and private keys. In the context of Android, these are used to digitally sign and secure an app. This provides a layer of security that prevents, among other things, remote attackers from pushing malicious updates to your application to market (all updates must be signed with the same key). The keystore is generated and...

records.summary: # App Store Product Page Every element of your App Store product page has the power to drive downloads of your iOS app. Learn how to help people discover your app and engage them through thoughtfully crafted metadata on your product page and in search results. ## App Name Your app’s name plays a critical role in how users discover it on the App Store. Choose a simple, memorable name that is easy to spell and hints...

records.summary: This Data Analytics Hub presentation gives public-safe operational guidance for Rock data quality programs: use built-in automation where possible, prioritize a small number of high-value data defects, move actionable cleanup reports into Rock, train a bounded volunteer team, and connect data quality work to ministry outcomes such as check-in, communication, and leadership reporting.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Data Analytics Hub session adds public-safe dashboard-design guidance for Rock reporting work: start with actionable questions, keep charts tied to decisions, avoid dashboards when a KPI or existing page element is enough, and treat historical Rock data differently depending on whether the source records are stable enough for comparison.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This RockCast update is useful public roadmap context: v8 was discussed as moving toward alpha testing, v9 was framed around volunteer scheduling, and Wi-Fi presence was described as an integration that maps campus Wi-Fi signals into Rock attendance-style insight. The episode also highlights privacy and data-ownership concerns when external services participate in presence tracking.
records.title: Episode 40: v8 and more team updates Transcript Insight

records.summary: CSS Grids A modern grid system for creating sophisticated and fluid layouts. records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session provides public-safe guidance for mobile app experiences that overlap with Rock groups, dynamic content, and engagement tracking. It frames the mobile app as a ministry surface where groups, content modules, profile-aware data, and communications can support a more personalized path for insiders.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session adds public-safe guidance for evaluating AI search and advanced digital experiences in Rock-backed websites and apps. It highlights the value of intent-based search, mobile and web integration, and careful plugin review before exposing AI-generated responses or search behavior to users.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session discusses a mobile-centered chat/community experience that connects staff and congregational communication patterns. It is useful as public-safe context for Rock Mobile planning because it surfaces expected chat features, push-notification behavior, group synchronization, and the need to keep staff web use and mobile user experience aligned.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session gives public-safe guidance for a daily mobile-app experience centered on scripture, prayer, and missions engagement. It is useful for Rock Mobile planning because it shows how a recurring app-open experience can connect daily content, serving or missions stories, push behavior, and engagement goals in a simple repeatable pattern.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This RockCast profile gives public-safe context that the Spark team was investing in core profile-page user experience work and Rock Mobile development at the same time. For the KB, the useful takeaway is that profile/person-facing UI, mobile app work, and developer onboarding are connected product surfaces rather than isolated documentation topics.
records.title: Episode 94: Special Edition with Jay Nestle Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session adds public-safe guidance for building a modular daily experience in a church mobile app. It describes using Rock Mobile as a recurring engagement surface for devotion, content, and practical next steps, with emphasis on flexible modules and analytics that show whether people return and engage over time.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session provides public-safe guidance for redesigning a Rock Mobile app homepage around engagement rather than navigation alone. The discussion highlights using the mobile app as a logged-in, ministry-owned surface, aligning homepage modules with current priorities, and measuring app content in ways that connect back to Rock data and ministry outcomes.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session is useful as public-safe context for community practice around emerging technology, mobile launches, and finance/workflow requests. It does not provide a single product tutorial, but it reinforces that Rock teams should bring concrete use cases to peer review, document what was tried, and separate experimentation from production changes.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub presentation provides public-safe guidance for churches evaluating AI. It frames AI as a fast-moving tool category that can assist ministry work, but requires clear use cases, privacy boundaries, staff training, review expectations, and model/vendor awareness before it is connected to Rock data or public-facing experiences.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: Automatic check-in is an option that works with family check-in and creates a speedier check-in process. With this configuration, when a family checks in, Rock pulls information from their previous check-in based on a certain number of days back. For example, if you have a weekly service, you can set up auto check-in to search a family check-in record ten days back and pull the same options as their check-in for the...

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session adds public-safe guidance for turning sermon and ministry video libraries into searchable, reusable digital content. It discusses selecting messages by pastoral value and audience response, using platform analytics without over-trusting them, and using AI as a planning aid for titles, categories, and follow-up content rather than as an unreviewed publisher.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session provides public-safe guidance for curating sermon or message content from external video analytics into a ministry-facing content library. It highlights the gap between YouTube-style analytics and Rock-backed ministry context, and it encourages topic tagging, content selection, and analytics exports that can guide what to feature without exposing raw platform data unnecessarily.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Digital Strategy Hub session focuses on short-form and on-demand video as part of a broader church digital strategy. It frames video as a way to extend message content, answer timely questions, route people into deeper next steps, and support mobile or web experiences that help people continue engaging after the weekend.
records.title: Media Watch Transcript Insight

records.summary: This Data Analytics Hub session adds public-safe guidance for group-matching research and external analytics tooling. It frames small-group matching as a data problem involving consistent survey design, privacy boundaries, aggregated results, and cross-church analysis, then shows how Rock analytics-enabled tables and external BI tools can support engagement snapshots and richer dashboard views.

records.summary: Note Types adds public-safe guidance for people-record governance: configure note categories intentionally, verify note-type visibility, and audit sensitive notes by type and entity context.
records.title: Note Types Transcript Insight

records.summary: Data View Overview strengthens the reporting guide by reinforcing Data Views as reusable qualifying-record definitions whose filters, persistence, and consumers must be checked before edits.
records.title: Data View Overview Transcript Insight

records.summary: Advanced HTML Block adds public-safe guidance for CMS security and Lava review: block authorship is privileged, and agents should inspect enabled commands, context inputs, and page/block authorization.
records.title: Advanced HTML Block Transcript Insight

records.summary: Data Integrity adds guidance for people and reporting work: prove the source of truth, understand cleanup ownership, and verify downstream reporting impact before changing records.
records.title: Data Integrity Transcript Insight

records.summary: Content Channel View adds public-safe CMS guidance: verify both content-channel configuration and page/block rendering paths when auditing what content is visible.
records.title: Content Channel View Transcript Insight

records.summary: Content Component adds CMS guidance for reusable content surfaces: locate all render points and ownership boundaries before changing a shared component.
records.title: Content Component Transcript Insight

records.summary: Personalization adds CMS/security guidance: targeted content should be tested with real actor state and must not be treated as a replacement for authorization.
records.title: Personalization Transcript Insight

records.summary: Connections Overview adds workflow guidance for engagement processes: connection requests should be audited as both person context and ministry process state.
records.title: Connections Overview Transcript Insight

records.summary: Form Builder adds workflow guidance: treat form fields as structured process inputs with validation, visibility, and downstream action implications.
records.title: Form Builder Transcript Insight

records.summary: Person Profile adds people/security guidance: profile work should identify the exact tab, block, action, and data surface before troubleshooting visibility or edit access.
records.title: Person Profile Transcript Insight

records.summary: Adding Pages and Blocks adds CMS guidance: page and block changes require route, hierarchy, zone, and inherited-security review.
records.title: Adding Pages and Blocks Transcript Insight

records.summary: Check-In Manager adds check-in guidance for live operations: diagnose active-session behavior from schedule, room, label, and manager-state evidence before changing configuration.
records.title: Check-In Manager Transcript Insight

records.summary: Giving Journey adds finance guidance: evaluate donor experience and back-office financial records together before changing giving processes or reports.
records.title: Giving Journey Transcript Insight

records.summary: Next-Gen Labels adds check-in guidance for label troubleshooting: validate template, merge data, routing, and active check-in context before treating failures as printer-only issues.
records.title: Next-Gen Labels Transcript Insight

records.summary: Connections Board adds workflow guidance for connection-request queues: troubleshoot visible cards through opportunity, status, assignment, filters, and security.
records.title: Connections Board Transcript Insight

records.summary: Connections List adds workflow guidance for filtered connection-request review: compare filters, opportunity, status, assignment, and user security when results differ.
records.title: Connections List Transcript Insight

records.summary: Connections Opportunities adds workflow guidance: opportunity configuration is a routing and reporting dependency, so active requests and staff ownership must be checked before edits.
records.title: Connections Opportunities Transcript Insight

records.summary: Connections Overview adds workflow guidance for connection ministries: separate person context, request status, opportunity setup, assignment, and automation when diagnosing issues.
records.title: Connections Overview Transcript Insight

records.summary: Connections Types adds workflow guidance: type boundaries should reflect ministry process design and must be reviewed for request, workflow, security, and reporting impact before restructuring.
records.title: Connections Types Transcript Insight

records.summary: Data Integrity adds operational guidance for cleanup and reporting quality: define correction rules, test known examples, and document ownership before data changes.
records.title: Data Integrity Transcript Insight

records.summary: Person Note adds people/security guidance: notes are structured staff context, so note type, visibility, lifecycle, and downstream consumers should be reviewed together.
records.title: Person Note Transcript Insight
